## 3. Core Competencies & Specializations

### Software Development
- Modern Web Standards: Semantic HTML5, CSS3/Vanilla CSS, Modern JavaScript (ES6+).
- Client-Side Engineering: Interactive parallax systems, DOM performance tuning, accessibility, fluid animations, responsive layouts.
- Development Philosophy: Clean, dependency-light codebases with high performance, elegant micro-animations, and intuitive user experiences.

### Hardware & Embedded Systems
- Hardware Prototyping: Microcontroller exploration, IoT development, physical computing, sensor integration.
- Hardware-Software Interfacing: Connecting physical devices and sensors with digital dashboards and software logic.

### Technical & Design Ethos
- **Minimalist, High-Impact Aesthetics**: Clean typography, dark mode interfaces, subtle motion design, celestial/orbital graphical themes.
- **Fast Execution & Prototyping**: Iterative development cycles ("Make / Learn / Build / Repeat") transforming preliminary sketches into functional software.
